items.headline: Jared Curtis scores 3 touchdowns as freshman QB helps Vanderbilt beat Delaware 35-26
items.description: — Jared Curtis ran for two touchdowns and threw his first career touchdown pass as Vanderbilt needed a 21-point third quarter to beat Delaware 35-26 on Saturday.

items.headline: Martel Hight credits Vandy coaches for honing his defensive skillset
items.description: Hight analyzes how he was able to attack the ball to come up with an interception and says Coach Lea and Rich have given him confidence in his defensive abilities.

items.headline: Clark Lea highlights Vandy's resilience in win vs. Delaware
items.description: Lea spotlights the Commodores' defense and assesses QB Jared Curtis' performance as he discusses how they were able to hold off the resilient Blue Hens.

items.headline: A fan as an offensive coordinator? How the Group of 6 is staying relevant in 2026
items.description: Akron let a fan call a drive, but how else is the Group of 6 keeping up with the rest of college football?

items.headline: Week 2 GameDay Kickoff: QB issues for Michigan, Buckeyes-Horns and more
items.description: The problems at QB run deep for Michigan, plus what to expect in Texas-Ohio State and other Week 2 games.

items.headline: Commodores' Lea: Berlowitz, Curtis both playing in Week 2
items.description: Clark Lea says Vandy QBs Blaze Berlowitz and Jared Curtis will continue to share snaps and calls the matchup with Delaware "personal" with alumni coaches on both sides.
